Called Meeting of City Council
Austin, Tex. June 12, 1879
Mayor De Gress presiding.
Roll called. Present Alderman.
Crov- Crooke, Millett, Platt, Raven
Strung, Vaughn, The following business
was transacted:

An ordinance amending article 344
(1) of the Revised Ordinances of the City of
Austin. Read first time and on motion the rules were suspended and the ordinance -ment
placed on its second reading by the following vote: Yeas Crov, Crooke, Millett
Platt, Raven, Strung, Vaughn. Yeas 7.
Nays- none-
Read second time, and on motion the
ordinance
amendment was placed on its third reading by the following vote: Yeas Crov, Crooke
Millett, Platt, Raven, Strung, Vaughn
Yeas- Seven- Nays- None-
Ordinance
Amendment read third time and on
motion passed by the following vote: Yeas Crov, Crooke, Millett, Platt, Raven, Strung,
Vaughn. Yeas: Seven. Nays. none.
Petition of Joseph Amon for a retail liquor license. Granted.
Petition of Mrs. I.E. Sullis for a reduction in the assessment of her property for the
year 1878.
On motion, the petition was laid on the
table on the ground that the city council had no authority to revise the action of the
board of appraising and equalization.
An ordinance fixing the per centum
of ad-valorem tax for the year A.D. 1879.
Read first time, and on motion the rules
were suspended and the ordinance placed
on its second reading by the following
vote. Crov, Crooke, Millett, Platt, Raven
Strung, Vaughn, Yeas seven, Nays
none-

rules were suspended and the ordinance
